searched_sources: Islamic Dawah Movement of Southern Africa (IDM - Durban, South Africa)
notes: The pioneer translation into Sesotho (Qur'an e Halalelang) by Sheikh Elias Keketso Lelia of the Lesotho Muslim Congregation was published and printed in Durban, South Africa by the Islamic Dawah Movement (IDM); no domestic printing press in Maseru produced it.
